description: Rogues who manifest psychic blades from the mind.

features.name: Psychic Blades
features.description: Create magical blades from psychic energy. Sneak attack uses d4 instead of d6.

features.name: Psionic Power
features.description: Telepathic communication. Detect creatures by thoughts.

features.name: Hone Psychic Blades
features.description: Psychic blades deal more damage and reappear magically.

features.name: Master Psychic Blades
features.description: Blades gain magical bonuses and can be thrown.
